name: "내가 알기로는", "내가 듣기로는", "내가 보기에는" - 자연스러운 영어를 위한 필수 표현 3가지

keywords.ko: +based on / according to(조금더 격식을 갖춘 표현)

keywords.en: As far as I know, that movie is releasing this week
keywords.ko: 내가 알기로는, 그 영화 이번 주에 개봉하는데
⇒ from what I hear (현재에도 이어나가는 정보나 소문)
⇒from what I’ve heard (현재 완료시제를 사용해서, 어떤 소문에 대해 지금까지 들어온이야기, 누적된 것)
공개된 내용이 아닌, 나에게 개인적으로 전달된 얘기에 대해서는

keywords.en: I was told that it would be the same this year

keywords.ko: 내가 보기에는 타이밍이 문제였어 (내 판단, 나한테에서 비롯되는 이야기이므로)

keywords.en: = As far as I can tell
keywords.ko: ⇒ The way I see it (관점에 대해서 이야기하는 것)
bold_words: As far as I can tell

keywords.en: The way I see it, the timing was the problem.
As far as I can tell the timing was the problem
As far as I know, the movie is  releasing this week
The way I see it, the timing was the problem

my_sentences.ko: as far as I know, she will arrive tomorrow 내가 알기로는 그녀가 내일 도착할거야

my_sentences.en: As far as I know, he is the best player on the team
my_sentences.ko: as far as I know, they are still open late  내가알기로는, 거기는 아직도 늦게까지 영업해
As far as I know, the meeting starts at noon. 내가 알기로는 미팅이 정오에 시작해
From what I hear, it’s going to rain tomorrow 내가 듣기로는, 내일 비가 올거래

my_sentences.en: From what I hear, she got the job
my_sentences.ko: From what I hear, the concert is sold out 내가듣기로는 그 콘서트는 이미 매진되었대
From what I hear, they are moving to a new city 내가 듣기로는, 그사람들이 새로운 도시로 이사간대
The way I see it, we should start early 내 생각에는 우리 일찍 시작하는게 좋을 거 같아
The way I see it, Everyone deserves a chance 내 생각에는 모두가 기회를 받을 자격이 있다고 봐
The way I see it, honesty is the best policy 내가 보기엔, 정직이 최선의 방책이야
The way I see it, teamwork makes dream work 내가보기엔, 협력이 있어야 목표를 이룰 수 있어

my_sentences.en: Based on what I know this book is very popular
my_sentences.ko: Based on what I know he is a great teacher 내가 아는한, 그는 훌륭한 선생님이야

my_sentences.en: Based on what I know, the weather will be nice tomorrow
Based on what I know, she speaks three languages
my_sentences.ko: From what I’ve heard, the movie is great 내가 들은바로는 그영화정말좋대

my_sentences.en: From what I’ve heard, it will rain tomorrow
my_sentences.ko: From what I’ve heard, the restaurant has amazing food 내가 듣기로는, 그 식당 음식 정말 맛있대

my_sentences.en: From what I’ve heard,  she’s a fantastic singer
my_sentences.ko: As far as I can tell, she is happy with her job내가보기엔, 그녀는 자신의 일에 만족하는 거같아
As far as I cantell, they are running late 내가보기엔, 사람들이 늦는 것 같아
As far as I can tell, the meeting was successful 내가보기엔 미팅이 성공적으로 끝난것 같아.
